top_signals.title: Insurers Rally as Stocks Shift from AI Loser to Safe Haven
top_signals.summary: US insurance-related stocks rallied Tuesday, pushing an industry gauge to close at a record, as artificial intelligence concerns drove traders toward defensive parts of the market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
